idea-plugin.name: Auto Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Auto Commit generates Git commit messages with AI directly inside IntelliJ IDEA. It reads your staged changes and streams a clear, ready-to-use commit message into the commit message field.

It supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and includes presets for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Qwen DashScope, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, and custom endpoints. API keys are saved in the plugin's local settings so you do not need to re-enter them every time you open the IDE.

  • One-click AI commit message generation from the IDEA Commit tool window.
  • Right-click the action button to choose a prompt convention and generate immediately.
  • Supports Conventional Commits, Gitmoji, simple style, and custom prompts.
  • Works with cloud providers and local models through Ollama or LM Studio.
  • Streams generated text directly into the commit message field and can be stopped anytime.
  • Supports multilingual output, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and custom languages.
  • Handles large diffs with automatic truncation and optional secret redaction.
  • Includes a status bar widget for quick provider and model switching.

中文简介

Auto Commit 是一个 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，可以根据暂存区代码变更，使用 AI 自动生成 Git commit message， 并将结果流式写入提交信息输入框。

插件支持 OpenAI 兼容接口，内置 OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM、 通义千问 DashScope、SiliconFlow、OpenRouter、Ollama、LM Studio 等预设，也支持自定义模型服务。 API Key 会保存到插件本地配置中，重新打开 IDE 后无需重复填写。

  • 在 IDEA Commit 窗口中一键生成提交信息。
  • 右键生成按钮可选择提示词规范，并立即按该规范生成。
  • 支持 Conventional Commits、Gitmoji、简洁模式和自定义提示词。
  • 支持云端模型，也支持 Ollama / LM Studio 本地模型。
  • 生成内容会流式写入 commit message，可随时停止。
  • 支持中文、英文、日文、韩文以及自定义输出语言。
  • 自动截断大 diff，并可对敏感信息进行脱敏。
  • 提供状态栏入口，方便快速切换服务商和模型。
